card.name: Punctuation and small words before list items
card.fires_on: Colons, commas, parentheses and small words like "of", "is" and "the" where a value or next list item is about to follow. Seen in trial record fields, cancer type lists and label sentences.

modes.description: Comma after ovarian in a list of related cancers.

modes.description: A short word like of or is that leads into a following phrase.
